page.overview:
What is The Stormlight Archive Series?

The Stormlight Archive is an epic fantasy series by American author Brandon Sanderson. The series is currently made up of 4 novels and 2 novellas but is planned to consist of around 10 books.

The Stormlight Archive has many magic systems. For information see The Stormlight Archive Magic Systems.

Sanderson finished his first draft of the Way of Kings in 2003, however he relized he told the story wrong, scratched the whole thing and started over. The original book came to be known as The Way of Kings Prime and can be found on the authors website.

The First book was released in 2010, Tor Books published sample chapters from The Way of Kings on its official website, along with an introduction by Sanderson. In its first week of release, The Way of Kings was No. 7 on The New York Times Best Seller list. In subsequent weeks the book was No. 11, No. 20, and No. 25.
